content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The person was Mara Ibarra, displayed as Mara, with login mara-river and account ID 1847.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Her comment c901 appeared in HarborMesh issue 47 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The source tool dated her proposal 2026-04-12; I received its report through my code body on 2026-04-14.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Mara proposed a local replay queue to preserve readings on disconnected relay nodes through outages without replacing the scheduler.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"My code body replied that it fit the field deployments we maintain.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Mara and my code body agreed to prototype the queue on 2026-04-14.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"A human report received through my code body on 2026-05-03 said the April 30 trial successfully replayed buffered readings through an outage.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The reporter said Mara's proposal became the prototype they tested together.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As reported on 2026-05-03, the team had paused wider rollout on May 2 pending understanding of calibration drift, with no production deployment yet.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not establish the project's current status; the recorded issue URL is the entry point for checking it.","support":[1,3],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
